title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
abstract: arXiv:2610.26770v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides

translated_title: HarnessPro：基于帕累托优化的递归式智能体框架自我改进方法，实现性能-成本权衡
translated_abstract: 智能体框架的开发在构建强大的AI智能体中起着至关重要的作用。近期的方法通过递归自我改进（RSI）来优化框架，但其性能提升往往伴随着更高的执行成本。我们提出了HarnessPro，这是一种无需标签的方法，用于演化智能体框架，在提升任务性能的同时降低执行成本。在该设置下，候选框架通过LLM生成的测试进行评估，无需访问真实标准答案或官方测试。专门的智能体负责诊断执行轨迹，根据不同的性能-成本优先级规划更新方案，并将其实现为候选框架。HarnessPro并非返回单一框架，而是采用归一化加权平方距离选择方法，为不同的部署预算提供侧重成本的精简版、均衡的中等版和侧重性能的重型版框架。被选中的框架进入下一轮迭代，执行反馈在此过程中持续引导改进……
tldr: HarnessPro提出了一种无需标签的智能体框架递归自我改进方法，通过帕累托优化权衡性能与执行成本，并提供精简、均衡、重型三种框架版本以适配不同的部署预算。
en_tdlr: HarnessPro introduces a label-free recursive self-improvement method for AI agent harnesses that leverages Pareto optimization to balance performance-cost trade-offs, offering lite, medium, and heavy harness variants tailored to different deployment budgets.
